title: 澤布呂赫液化天然氣接收站
summary: 澤布呂赫液化天然氣接收站是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為再氣化與轉運並行的存量分配；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
summaryEn: Zeebrugge LNG is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on inventory allocation between simultaneous regasification and transshipment, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 再氣化與轉運並行的存量分配
v31FocusEn: inventory allocation between simultaneous regasification and transshipment

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：澤布呂赫液化天然氣接收站
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Zeebrugge LNG
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存」與「液體加壓與效率：再氣化與轉運並行的存」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Regasification thermal duty — case 1" and "Liquid pumping and efficiency — case 2": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Regasification thermal duty — case 1" is correct?
options: 再氣化需要把低溫液體變成指定送出狀態的氣體，熱量包含升溫與相變。
液化氣只要降低壓力就不需要任何熱源。
泵的額定電機功率就是所有流量下的實際功率。
optionsEn: Regasification turns a cold liquid into gas at a specified delivery state, requiring sensible and phase-change heat.
Reducing LNG pressure removes every need for a heat source.
Rated motor power equals actual power at every flow rate.
quiz.explanation: 再氣化需要把低溫液體變成指定送出狀態的氣體，熱量包含升溫與相變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Regasification turns a cold liquid into gas at a specified delivery state, requiring sensible and phase-change heat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Regasification thermal duty — case 1: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存」如何決定「澤布呂赫液化天然氣接收站」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Regasification thermal duty — case 1” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Zeebrugge LNG”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本工程研究問題是「再氣化與轉運並行的存量分配」。以澤布呂赫液化天然氣接收站作為地理與系統脈絡，本單元建立可驗證的教學假設；下列模型並非宣稱該場址採用相同設備尺寸、工況或流程。再氣化需要把低溫液體變成指定送出狀態的氣體，熱量包含升溫與相變。先以質量流量乘等效焓差求熱負載，再檢查熱源流量；海水、空氣或燃燒提供熱量的可用性不同，模型中的等效焓差並不代表任何設備的實際設定。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case question is inventory allocation between simultaneous regasification and transshipment. Using Zeebrugge LNG as geographic and system context, this unit constructs a testable teaching scenario; it does not assert that the site has the same dimensions, conditions or flowsheet as the model. Regasification turns a cold liquid into gas at a specified delivery state, requiring sensible and phase-change heat. First multiply mass flow by equivalent enthalpy rise, then examine the required heat-source flow. Seawater, air and combustion have different availability; the teaching enthalpy rise is not an equipment setting. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存」的模型 Q[MW]=m[kg/s]·Δh[kJ/kg]/1000，教學假設，非場址設計值：假設送出量的再氣化熱負載最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q[MW]=m[kg/s]·Δh[kJ/kg]/1000 for "Regasification thermal duty — case 1", which value is closest to the teaching assumption, not site design data: regasification duty for a hypothetical send-out rate?
options: 620 MW
optionsEn: 620 MW
quiz.explanation: Q[MW]=m[kg/s]·Δh[kJ/kg]/1000；代入 m = 75.6 kg/s、dh = 820 kJ/kg，得 62.0 MW（教學假設，非場址設計值：假設送出量的再氣化熱負載）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q[MW]=m[kg/s]·Δh[kJ/kg]/1000; with m = 75.6 kg/s, dh = 820 kJ/kg the result is 62.0 MW (teaching assumption, not site design data: regasification duty for a hypothetical send-out rate). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Regasification thermal duty — case 1: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Regasification thermal duty — case 1” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q[MW]=m[kg/s]·Δh[kJ/kg]/1000；代入 m = 75.6 kg/s、dh = 820 kJ/kg，得 62.0 MW（教學假設，非場址設計值：假設送出量的再氣化熱負載）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 m 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q[MW]=m[kg/s]·Δh[kJ/kg]/1000; with m = 75.6 kg/s, dh = 820 kJ/kg the result is 62.0 MW (teaching assumption, not site design data: regasification duty for a hypothetical send-out rate). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise m by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：m 增加 10% 時，結果變為 68.2 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising m by 10% changes the result to 68.2 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 62.0 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 m 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 62.0 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in m with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Regasification thermal duty — case 1"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對再氣化與轉運並行的存量分配，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For inventory allocation between simultaneous regasification and transshipment, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data.
quiz.explanation: 針對再氣化與轉運並行的存量分配，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For inventory allocation between simultaneous regasification and transshipment, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Regasification thermal duty — case 1: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Regasification thermal duty — case 1” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對再氣化與轉運並行的存量分配，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。分別用產品側焓升與熱源側流量乘比熱乘溫降做雙重熱平衡；加入量測誤差後，比較兩側差異是否在合成不確定度內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For inventory allocation between simultaneous regasification and transshipment, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data. Calculate duty independently from product enthalpy rise and heat-source flow times heat capacity times temperature drop. Add measurement errors and compare the two balances against combined uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保留熱源環境條件與產品交付狀態，避免把冬季與夏季負載直接比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain heat-source conditions and product delivery state before comparing winter and summer demand.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低熱源溫度會降低可送出量，溫度計偏差則可能讓熱平衡看似不閉合；應用另一組溫度與流量資料區分熱源不足與量測偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A colder heat source can restrict send-out, while thermometer bias creates an apparent heat-balance mismatch. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Regasification thermal duty — case 1" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 低熱源溫度會降低可送出量，溫度計偏差則可能讓熱平衡看似不閉合；應用另一組溫度與流量資料區分熱源不足與量測偏移。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
泵的額定電機功率就是所有流量下的實際功率。
optionsEn: A colder heat source can restrict send-out, while thermometer bias creates an apparent heat-balance mismatch.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Rated motor power equals actual power at every flow rate.
quiz.explanation: 低熱源溫度會降低可送出量，溫度計偏差則可能讓熱平衡看似不閉合；應用另一組溫度與流量資料區分熱源不足與量測偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A colder heat source can restrict send-out, while thermometer bias creates an apparent heat-balance mismatch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Regasification thermal duty — case 1: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「再氣化熱負載：再氣化與轉運並行的存」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Regasification thermal duty — case 1” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低熱源溫度會降低可送出量，溫度計偏差則可能讓熱平衡看似不閉合；應用另一組溫度與流量資料區分熱源不足與量測偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「澤布呂赫液化天然氣接收站」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: A colder heat source can restrict send-out, while thermometer bias creates an apparent heat-balance mismatch. knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 流量計比例偏差與效率劣化都會改變比耗，低溫液體的相態變化也可能破壞不可壓縮假設；應先審查量測與工況，再解讀模型偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Flow-meter scale bias and efficiency deterioration both affect specific energy, while phase change can invalidate the incompressible assumption. Review measurements and operating state before interpreting model residuals.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 證據版本
knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
